title: Homework 3 (Handwritten) — Waveguides and Transmission Lines
preamble: Handwritten submission. Work each problem on a fresh sheet of paper, photograph your pages, and mark which region answers each part. Do not write your name or student ID on your answer pages. Write clearly; keep exponents and subscripts legible.

problems.name: TE10 Mode in a Rectangular Waveguide
problems.description: An air-filled rectangular waveguide has inner dimensions a = 2.29 cm and b = 1.02 cm (WR-90).

subsections.name: Cutoff frequency
subsections.description: Determine the cutoff frequency of the dominant TE10 mode. Show your use of f_c = c / (2a).

subsections.name: Guide wavelength at 10 GHz
subsections.description: Operating at 10 GHz, compute the guide wavelength lambda_g for the TE10 mode.

subsections.name: Field sketch and justification
subsections.description: Sketch the transverse E-field of the TE10 mode across the cross-section and briefly justify the location of the maximum.

problems.name: Terminated Transmission Line
problems.description: A lossless 50-ohm line is terminated in a load Z_L = 75 + j25 ohm and operated at a frequency where the line is 0.30 wavelengths long.

subsections.name: Reflection coefficient
subsections.description: Compute the load reflection coefficient Gamma_L in magnitude and angle.

subsections.name: VSWR and input impedance
subsections.description: Find the VSWR on the line and the input impedance seen at the source end.
